name: sonora-design
description: Design System panel for this repo, hosted in a VS Code webview — feature parity with claude.ai/design's own panel (see docs/EXTENSION-PLAN.md).

sonora.python.description: Interpreter used to run docs/serve.py and docs/gen_gallery.py.

sonora.serverPort.description: Port the gallery server (docs/serve.py) answers on. docs/serve.py itself always binds 8888 — see extension/lib/server.js's header comment before changing this.
